commitResults.messageTitle: feat: rename Duke to hermes-mini and add greet-and-exit
commitResults.messageBody: Rename the starter chatbot Duke -> hermes-mini (class HermesMini) and implement Level 0: print the ASCII banner, greet the user, then say goodbye and exit. Fill the AGENTS.md student-profile blanks and fix the Java-version note to match this machine (JDK 26 via java_home, no sdkman). Refresh README/docs Duke references and ignore *.class files.
